notes.title: Patch 2025.09.01: Optimization and Usability
notes.content: [p]Hi Everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to finally get this update out! In the months following our early access release, we were primarily focused on quickly fixing any bugs you guys brought to our attention and making incremental changes to improve the LAN Party experience. However, over the last month or so, our development focus has been on overhauling core LAN Party features, as well as implementing a few new ones we've been eyeing for a while.[/p][p][/p][p]One of the major pain points of the application so far has been the time it takes to load a room. Our goal here was to optimize the loading process as much as possible to both improve load times and reduce the compute/memory resources required to load large rooms. To that end, we implemented a significantly more efficient model loader that drastically improves the time it takes to load a 3D model and reduces the amount of memory 3D models use while loaded. This is the most noticeable when importing assets in the Asset Importer. We also implemented a new asset caching system that further improves loading times by no longer having to download an asset after its been loaded at least once. In addition, we've made some optimizations on the database side to shave a few seconds while loading into a room as well. There is still more time that can be saved on the database side, and despite our lack of expertise on that front we've still found multiple optimizations that we are currently working on. (Note: The new importer is specifically for FBX and OBJ room assets. Avatars still use the previous importer since there is much more complexity.)[/p][p][/p][p]We also decided to give the Blueprint mode a bit of an overhaul. Previously, if you wanted to adjust your floor plan, you had to press the "Clear" button and start over from scratch. Now, you can move and delete existing wall points, as well as "split" existing walls to create a new wall point that can be moved around. This should hopefully save a lot of headache when designing a complex room![/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, you can now preview avatars and assets on the marketplace before you use them! When you click on an avatar or asset in the marketplace or your library, there is now a "Preview" button on the bottom of its thumbnail. Clicking this will open a 3D preview of the asset where you can move the camera around to see it at all angles. For avatars, you can preview what the avatar looks like performing animations. Humanoid avatar will execute the humanoid animations you currently have set, and generic avatars will execute the animations they have set in the appropriate slots.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868695/c6ebc0451d7886d1b4117117abac23c6f941efcb.png"][/img][/p][p]You can view room assets with the previewer as well. For seating, you can hit the "Preview with Avatars" button to see what it looks like with your current avatar sitting on it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868695/6482c3b2e382c89d536a1b610784ca90b636ff04.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks to your suggestions, we also added nameplates above other avatars in the room! This can be turned on/off in Settings -> Gameplay. You can also set your profile color in Settings -> My Account by clicking on the square next to your profile picture.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868695/596b304850068fbf5532dac526ef2b7b4c09cfa6.png"][/img][/p][p]This controls what color your nameplate is for other people, as well as the color your nameplate shows up as in chat.[/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of chat, we added rich text (BBCode) support in chat, which lets you control the font size, color, and boldness of your messages. Documentation of the different modifiers can be found here: [url="https://www.bbcode.org/reference.php"]https://www.bbcode.org/reference.php[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this update! We have another one planned in the next couple of weeks focused around saving/loading room templates and sharing them on the marketplace. As always, feel free to join our Discord and DM me (Ryan) if you have any suggestions or run into any issues![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/yVEQHDaY37"]https://discord.gg/yVEQHDaY37[/url][/p][p][/p][p]IMPORTANT: If any of your assets have their textures messed up by the new asset importer, please DM me on Discord and I'll help you out.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 3D previewer to marketplace/library.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to move/delete existing wall points as well as split walls to create new wall points.[/p][/*][*][p]Added nameplates over other players in the room.[/p][/*][*][p]Added profile color in settings that controls the color of your nameplate and your name in chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Added rich text (BBCode) support to chat.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Implemented new asset importer that drastically reduces load times and memory usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Added local asset caching system to improve network efficiency and overall performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Added/improved several icons throughout the application.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added additional logic for preventing room blueprints from being in a broken/incomplete state.[/p][/*][*][p]Non-owners of rooms will be returned to the main menu when entering a room in a broken state.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where the hotkey help panel would not be in the correct state.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where hitting ESC with certain panels open could duplicate them.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 2025.08.1
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Hope you've been enjoying LAN Party! This patch contains many QoL improvements and bug fixes, as well as the ability to invite friends to your room using a room code rather than direct Steam invites. We have a few major features and updates set to release in the next couple of weeks, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]Features:[/p][list][*][p]Added a system for inviting friends to a room using a generated code.[/p][list][*][p]This can be found on the top of the "Invite Friends" window.[/p][/*][*][p]When creating a room code, you can specify both the number of days the code will work for as well as the number of times it can be used. You can also set codes to never expire and be used an unlimited amount of times.[/p][/*][*][p]After generating a code, you can copy it to your clipboard using the icon to the right of the code.[/p][/*][*][p]You can also delete codes and make them stop working by hitting the trash can icon next to the code.[/p][/*][*][p]To enter a code a friend has given you, paste the code in the text box on the bottom right of the "My Rooms" menu and you will be added to the room.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a version history with change log. To access this, click on the version number on the bottom right of the "Settings" menu.[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where streams would not appear on screens placed at very specific angles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where players would get stuck at 100% while loading into a room after leaving and rejoining in the same session.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where loading an object into a room could get stuck at 100%.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where floors/walls/ceilings could become moveable in Decor mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where rapidly pressing the "Use RPM" checkbox in the "Ready Player Me" menu could leave copies of avatars stuck t-posing in the middle of the room.[/p][/*][/list][p]Improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Closing the help panel by clicking the "?" will keep it closed in subsequent sessions so you don't need to close it every time you launch.[/p][/*][*][p]Visibility of all help panels are now synced so closing one will close all of them.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an "uploading" indicator to avatar and asset importers.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 2025.07.5: CO-OP ROOM DESIGN!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to announce the release of a highly requested feature: co-op room design! Now you and you friends can edit and design the same room at the same time. We're looking forward to seeing what you create together![/p][p][/p][p]To give your friend the ability to edit your room with you, go to "Admin Settings" in the dropdown at the top of the screen while in the room. All members of the room will be listed with checkboxes next to them representing different permissions you can grant them. Once you check the "Editor" checkbox next to your friend's name, they will be able to edit your room. You can also check the "Moderator" box to allow them to invite and kick players from your room. You can revoke these permissions at any time if need be.[/p][p][/p][p]We also have several improvements and bug fixes included in this patch and we have more features in the works for the near future.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for playing LAN Party![/p][p][/p][p][b]Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added two player permissions that can be granted to room members by the room owner. Only the room owner can grant permissions to players.[/p][list][*][p]Editor: The player can fully edit the room in design mode[/p][/*][*][p]Moderator: The player can invite and kick other players from the room[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]If two or more players can edit a room, they can edit the room at the same time[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]While in freecam, you can now zoom using the scroll wheel[/p][/*][*][p]Stream settings (resolution & FPS) will now default to the settings you used in your previous session[/p][/*][*][p]Asset reflectivity will be initialized to 0 when importing it in the asset creation viewport[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where the UI would become reenabled after unfocusing and refocusing on LAN Party while in No-UI mode[/p][/*][*][p]You will no longer exit freecam mode after interacting with screens or remote streams[/p][/*][*][p]Cursor will no longer become hidden after swapping avatars[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where avatar gravity would be disabled after standing up the first frame the avatar started sitting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rare error when sitting/standing really fast that could lock avatar movement[/p][/*][*][p]Assets with missing zip file texture dependencies will still be visible in room[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 2025.06.02: VRM Support
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for all of your support! Its been very encouraging to see how many people are enjoying LAN Party. We've got a lot of bug fixes, QoL improvement, and new features included in this update:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868695/d254362941432321f524c0a8b7b8c393da6ff84b.png"][/img](avatar credit: [url="https://hub.vroid.com/en/characters/7555704048104097018/models/7478519881453759545"]https://hub.vroid.com/en/characters/7555704048104097018/models/7478519881453759545[/url])[/p][p][/p][p][b]Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Full VRM avatar support (Create -> Avatar -> VRM)[/p][list][*][p]Supports included physics[/p][/*][*][p]Configurable blinking[/p][/*][*][p]Mouth movement synced with mic audio[/p][/*][*][p]Toggleable facial expressions[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added fullscreen mode (Settings -> Video -> Fullscreen)[/p][list][*][p]Added the ability to exit LAN Party without being in windows mode. Select "Exit LAN Party" from the in-room top menu while in a room or just hit ESC while not in a room to open the quitting popup[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added the ability to pan the camera in Blueprint mode[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased maximum room square footage[/p][/*][*][p]Increased maximum ceiling height[/p][/*][*][p]Increased maximum ceiling lights[/p][/*][*][p]Rooms without a set thumbnail now have a default thumbnail[/p][/*][*][p]Changed gear button in Decor mode to "Lighting" for improved clarity[/p][/*][*][p]My Rooms menu now opens automatically after leaving a room[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Edit Room" button to in-room UI for improved clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Blueprint and Decor modes now have different help panels to avoid confusion[/p][/*][*][p]In-room help panel now has more controls listed[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Spawn point is now reset to a valid position if out of bounds in a concave room[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where if two users were interacting with different screens, the first users stream would be placed on both screens[/p][/*][*][p]Steam friends added during LAN Party session will now appear in "Invite Friends" menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Loading...100%" staying on the screen forever after loading into a room with no walls[/p][/*][*][p]In-room UI no longer overlaps decor/blueprint UI after entering room with an incomplete wall loop. If you've opened a room and have had the main menu button overlapping the clear walls button, this fixes that[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this update! We've got a lot planned for our next update as well, so stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Update and 700 Concurrent Players
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Just launched our charts this morning and saw that we hit 700 concurrent players! Welcome to everyone playing LAN Party for the first time![/p][p][/p][p]I just wanted to let everyone know that we have an update in the works set to release later today. This is a major patch that will feature several bug fixes and QoL improvements, as well as multiple new features including full VRM avatar support! This will include preserving all VRM physics, configurable blinking, mouth movement synced with mic audio, as well as toggleable facial expressions.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868695/fd60573e7709eeffbfc9c9982a8523298bd5add6.png"][/img](credit: [url="https://hub.vroid.com/en/characters/4241258680178962729/models/8368642706329814844"]https://hub.vroid.com/en/characters/4241258680178962729/models/8368642706329814844[/url])[/p][p]We've got even more cool stuff planned for the upcoming week, so keep your eyes peeled![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for supporting us, and we hope you enjoy the new update! If you have any feedback or run into any issues, please let us know! Feel free to join our discord as well and don't hesitate to send me (Ryan) a DM if you want to discuss anything in detail: [url="https://discord.gg/sySWBZ6F"]https://discord.gg/sySWBZ6F[/url][/p]

notes.title: Patch 2025.06.1
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Thank you so much for all of your support thus far! We've been hard at work fixing bugs and making improvements based on your feedback. While there is a lot included in this patch, we have even more changes planned to release later this week. If you have any feedback for us or encounter any issues, feel free to join our [url="https://discord.gg/E5NdWFV2"]Discord[/url] and let us know about it. We're always looking to improve LAN Party as much as possible and your feedback helps us out a ton.[/p][p][/p][p]Features:[/p][list][*][p]Added an option for walls, ceilings, and floors in room designer to preserve the aspect ratio of textures.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a slider in audio settings to adjust the volume of incoming streams.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to test your mic audio in audio settings in order to easily select the correct input device. Includes a bar that displays the audio energy of your voice.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option in camera settings to invert y-axis.[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where walls from previous room would appear in blueprint mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Bottom right mic/stream buttons no longer show up in avatar and asset importers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with the camera clipping through walls/objects at certain angles.[/p][/*][/list][p]Improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Added a button to close the marketplace/library when viewing a specific asset.[/p][/*][*][p]Added interactable text box for seeing/changing the scale value for assets in room designer.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an "Invite Friends" button in the room UI to make inviting friends to rooms easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Made button to start/stop streaming on the bottom right more clear.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We will also be pushing out an experimental branch tomorrow to add stability and fix issues regarding blueprint mode. These are some major foundational changes, so we wanted to make sure this gets fully tested before putting it out on the main branch. This branch will include:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Extensive sanity check for rooms when loading in. This will validate if the room contains a true loop between any of its walls. It will display only the walls in the correct loop and delete all rooms not included. This should fix issues people had where their room bugged and had a bunch of junk walls but they couldn't draw or clear the room. Since this has the capacity to delete walls, we want to test this further to avoid catastrophe.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where "Loading... 100%" would get stuck on the screen forever if the room has no current walls[/p][/*][*][p]When loading into a room without a complete loop, the in-room UI will no longer be overlayed on top of the blueprint/room designer UI. If you've had an issue where the main menu button is covering the "Clear" button in blueprint mode, this fixes that.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We will also be experimenting with fixing some things for Linux users. At the moment, streaming or receiving streams will crash the app for Linux users. We will try a few things on our end to prevent this, but if there are any players out there who have experienced these issues on a Linux machine we would love your help testing this out.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again everyone![/p]

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

Thank you so much for supporting LAN Party! Just wanted to share a few announcements:

First, the not-so-fun news. We'll have to move our early access release date to May 22nd due to some unforeseen circumstances surrounding our approval on Steam. We were alerted last week that Steam will need additional time to review LAN Party and we are still awaiting approval. We don't know for certain why additional time is needed or how much is needed, so we decided to push back our release three weeks to ensure that the approval process is completed before we hit our release date. Steam might just be overloaded with work due to the Steam Wargames Fest that just started or it might be due to the fact that we are a pretty non-traditional Steam release, but that's just speculation.

On the bright side, this gives us some additional time to polish LAN Party a bit more and get some valuable feedback before our release. We're planning on hosting some closed testing sessions leading up to release if anyone is interested in trying out early and giving us some valuable feedback. We're a small development team, so your feedback and suggestions are very important in helping us map out our development priorities moving forward.

If you are interested in helping us test or have any questions about LAN Party or our future development plans, feel free to join our Discord: https://discord.gg/MKMEfa2B


Thanks again for your support, and we hope to see you all in LAN Party soon!
